mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures that may lead to tighter monetary policy, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals growing demand in the economy, which is likely to boost corporate earnings and positively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative sentiment and lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% MoM and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 3% year-over-year, it indicates a potential overheating economy with loose monetary policy, which can lead to inflation and negatively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: overheating economy with loose monetary policy
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which can boost consumer spending and positively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals robust consumer demand and a tight labor market, which can positively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: robust consumer demand and tight labor market
failure_condition: If RSAFS YoY > 5% and UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 3% quarter-over-quarter signals strong economic growth, which can lead to higher corporate earnings and positively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases > 3% QoQ and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.
